sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Satin Rose Flower Hair Tie – Set of 2
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elegant satin rose flower hair tie, set of 2 (pink & cream)
Soft stretchable elastic band, gentle on hair
Aesthetic rosette design adds a chic touch to any hairstyle
Perfect for daily wear, college, parties & gifting
Doubles as a bracelet/wrist accessory when not in hair
Lightweight, no-damage grip for all hair types
